attchmntText: ABC Industries India Limited has informed regarding intimation under regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015
voiceSummary: ABC Industries India Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved acquiring up to 7,50,000 equity shares of AB Cotton Textiles Private Limited at Rs. 800 per share, aggregating to a maximum consideration of Rs. 60,00,00,000. The acquisition is subject to requisite approvals and execution of a Share Purchase Agreement. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of Rs. 567.12 lacs and a net profit of Rs. 190.29 lacs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 2.58. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026.
